rows.en: We have intel that the Reclaimers are putting their plan to raise <pic(0)><cs(3)>Orphan<ce()> into action.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: They say that if Orphan surfaces, it'll absorb Earth's bio-energy and drain the land dry.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: If that is true, we must stop it at all costs.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: We are also <mk(75,-31,6,0)><ar(0,6,0,150)><mk(83,-56,6,3,50)><ar(0,6,3,150)>setting course for Orphan, and will join the fight immediately.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: We have confirmed that the Reclaimers' main force has been destroyed.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: With their fighting strength gone, the Reclaimers have agreed to accept our protection.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: And now that the surfacing plan has been stopped, Orphan has quietly ceased moving too.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: From here, a team of researchers will take over and work out new countermeasures.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: This era is surely heading toward peace. Our role, too, will soon be over.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: We can't stand still if we want peace. Don't let your guard down, even for an instant.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)
